_doc: Infinite brand tokens v2 for brand surfaces (website, films, thumbnails, social, docs, installers, 3D). The app's own UI values live in src/app/ui/design/tokens.json and src/core/CategoryColors.cpp. Edit here, then run python3 tools/brand/build_brand_book.py (book, brand.css, DTCG tokens, contrast gate) and the Blender kit tools/brand/build_3d.py.

idea.concept: Two ends, one loop. The lemniscate's warm end (Ember) is the human act: the hand word, the key cable, the call to action. Its cool end (Signal, on the Midnight hue) is the structure: lines, diagrams, data. Midnight is the space they connect across.

colour._doc: Every value is defined and checked in OKLCH (tools/brand/colour.py). The cool family sits on one hue (274), the warm family on one hue (38).

midnight.role: Neutrals: grounds, surfaces, inks. Never pure black or white.

signal.role: Structure: lines, diagrams, data, focus, selection.

ember.role: The accent: one look-here per frame.

midnight._doc: Dark. The default for films, social, thumbnails and showcase sections. The logo tile colour.

mist._doc: Light, cool. Diagrams, science plates, panels shown on light, docs headers.

paper._doc: Light, neutral. Reading surfaces: website body, docs, PDFs, manuals, release notes.

contrast_gate._doc: The build fails if any pair is below its WCAG 2.2 ratio. APCA Lc is printed as a perceptual guide only.

gradient.name: Brand gradient
gradient.role: The logo's own colour: warm end to cool end. Horizontal, exact stops. Logo, brand ball and end-card lockup only.

iridescence.role: Thin-film sweep for one hero object per frame (ball, sphere, glass ring). Never on type or UI.

retired.name: Coral (v1 accent on dark)
retired.why: owner-approved film palette r5/r6 moved the warm end to a cleaner orange; coral survives only as the gradient's first stop #F57F66

retired.name: Terracotta
retired.why: one warm hue on every mode; terracotta was a second warm family

retired.name: Terracotta ink
retired.why: same hue as the accent, passes 4.5 on Paper and Mist

retired.name: Violet glow
retired.why: owner r5: no violet on violet; two cool hues competed

retired.name: Warm ink
retired.why: one neutral family on the Midnight hue for every mode

retired.name: Bone (film r5 ink)
retired.why: matches the app's own text colour; one neutral family

retired.name: Cobalt ground
retired.why: owner r6b picked Paper over Cobalt

migrate._doc: Extra one-to-one swaps for tools/brand/migrate_colours.py: v1 warm tints that were never named. Shadows move to the brand shadow #1A1F36.

families.name: Geist
families.role: Everything people read: headlines, UI, body.

families.name: Geist Mono
families.role: Machine text: values with units, code, node types, folios, coordinates.

families.name: Caveat
families.role: The one human word per scene or section. Ember, hand underline, 1.5x its neighbours.

families.name: Pixel 5x7
families.role: Drawn, not a font file. Only when the machine itself speaks (prediction, learning).

numerals._doc: Numbers are a voice of their own (after Giovanni Pintori's Olivetti posters built from figures). Big figures in Geist, the unit small in mono beside them.

web_scale.role: One hero figure per page: a benchmark, a count, a price.
Stat tiles in a row of two to four.

numerals.index: Section and card indexes are two-digit mono folios (01, 02): 'Folio mono caps' step, ink-3, never Ember.
rules: Tabular, lining figures on anything that changes or lines up.
Value, thin space, unit: 120 BPM, -6.0 dB, 48 kHz. The unit never wraps away from its value.
Ratios and pairs use a slash in ink-3 with a space each side: 05 / 09, 3871 / 03:12.
A figure counts up once, on first view, over a page duration (667 ms) with ease-out; reduced motion shows the final value.
Never a fake or rounded-up figure; every number on the site is measured or counted (BRAND.md section 11).

kinetic._doc: Type that moves on the web. Moves come from the motion laws (section 8); this lists which ones type may use.

allowed.what: A headline's words rise 0.5 em into place on the slab spring, word stagger 42 ms (1/32 triplet).
allowed.when: Once, the first time the headline is seen.

allowed.what: One word cycles through a list (the 'A DAW for you' line). Out with ease-in 125 ms, in with the letter spring.
allowed.when: Every 2 bars (4 s at 120 BPM). Stops when the tab is hidden.

allowed.what: The Caveat word's hand underline draws pin to pin with ease-out over 500 ms.
A numeral counts to its value (type.numerals).
A short mono line travels along a programme path (circle or lemniscate), one lap per 8 bars (16 s).
allowed.when: Decoration only, one per page, aria-hidden, the words repeated as real text nearby.

never: Infinite animation on body text or anything people have to read.
More than 15 characters per second on screen.
Scroll-jacked type, per-letter wobble loops, blur-in on body copy, typewriter on headlines longer than 3 words.
Kinetic type under prefers-reduced-motion: it appears in its final state.

curved._doc: Curved type sits on a path the brand already owns.
paths: lemniscate from the logo formula (never drawn as the mark itself)
curved.style: Folio mono caps, 12 px minimum, ink-2, tracking +0.12 em
rules: Decoration only; the same words appear as real text.
Never on a headline, a button or body copy.

logo.curve: Lemniscate of Bernoulli: x = A sin p / (1 + cos^2 p), y = A sin p cos p / (1 + cos^2 p), p in [0, 2 pi)
logo.aspect: 2.341 : 1 with stroke (2 sqrt 2 : 1 for the centre line)
logo.crossing: the branches cross at 90 degrees, each at 45 degrees to the axis

tile._doc: Measured from the shipped 1024 icon (assets/Infinite.iconset) by tools/brand/build_logo.py --check. The shipped tile is #1D223B; the next icon install moves it to Midnight #151930.

brand_radius.name: Card
brand_radius.role: Every card: node card, panel, film frame, step, modal. 20 on phones.

brand_radius.name: Media
brand_radius.role: Inside a card: card radius minus its 8 px padding. 12 on phones.

springs.name: slab
springs.role: Patch Type slabs, the key cable snap. The signature.

node3d._doc: How a node card becomes a physical object. Units: 1 u = 1 app px at 100% UI scale. tools/brand/build_3d.py reads this block.

card._note: 440 content (the Audio Filter body width) + 2 x 12 padding. Jacks sit in the side walls like a pedal, so the card is 18 thick: a 14 jack ring (r_cable 7) fits with 2 to spare top and bottom.

knob._note: One knob size since v0.5 (kKnobStd 56; kKnobLarge = kKnobSmall). Hierarchy comes from grouping and order, never size.
knob.pointer: engraved line from 0.25 to 0.9 of cap radius, Moon
knob.arc: printed on the card at 1.14 of the knob radius, 270 degrees, Signal; the modulation arc sits outside it in the Modulation role colour

jack.where: side walls at the pin row: input left, output right

cable.base: source category colour; the key cable is Ember

light._doc: Azimuth from +x counter-clockwise, card lying in XY with its title edge toward +Y and the camera on the -Y side. Key upper-left behind (135), rim upper-right behind (45), fill from the camera.

node3d.reference: Audio Filter (src/app/bodies/FxBodies1.cpp, docs/plans/ui-system/element-sizes.md): body 440, readout strip 21, response viewer 190, row of 4 cells of 110 (type dropdown, freq, Q, gain), output row (mix, env)

channels.size: Markdown, sentence case, no em dashes
SVG, PNG 1024, mark + tile, light and dark

render._doc: Targets for tools/brand/channels.py. safe = [x, y, w, h] in px where text and the mark must sit (platform UI and crops cover the rest); hero layouts use a 6% margin.

lineage._doc: The art movement the brand descends from, and what each idea becomes on a brand surface. Section 16 of BRAND.md.
lineage.movement: Arte Programmata (programmed and kinetic art), Milan, 1962
lineage.people: Bruno Munari and Giorgio Soavi (organisers), Umberto Eco (catalogue), Gruppo T (Milan), Gruppo N (Padua), Enzo Mari; shown in the Olivetti showroom
lineage.method: Karl Gerstner, Designing Programmes (1964): a design is a programme, a set of rules with variables, not a fixed layout
lineage.why: Infinite is a programme you play. Arte Programmata made art from rules, motors and chance that a visitor completes by watching or touching; a patch is the same thing with cables. Gerstner turned the same idea into a method for grids and type, which is how a website can carry it.

principles.name: Programme, not layout
principles.from: Gerstner: the grid as a programme for x unknown items; the maximum of constants with the greatest variability
principles.rule: Every component is a rule with variables: tokens and fluid clamps, never one-off sizes. The 12-column grid divides into 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6.

principles.name: The open work
principles.from: Eco's catalogue: a work the viewer completes
principles.rule: Every page has one thing to touch that answers within a 1/16 note (125 ms). The visitor finishes the piece. A DAW for you.

principles.name: Programmed, not predictable
principles.from: Munari and Gruppo T: motors and rules that give results no one fully foresees
principles.rule: Variation comes from a seed and the phase law (L5): siblings never move in step, and the same seed gives the same frame.

principles.name: The thing itself
principles.from: Gruppo N: the work is to be observed as the thing itself, not a picture of something else
principles.rule: Show the real product, real node names and real values. No stock images, no device mockups, no fake figures.

principles.name: Signed together
principles.from: Gruppo N signed works as a collective
principles.rule: Open source: credit community patches by name, link the code, publish the measurements.

signature.name: Programmed field
signature.what: A grid of unit marks (dot, ring, square, cross, plus, and the Pixel 5x7 digits) whose choice and size are driven by a signal: audio, noise or the pointer.
signature.colour: Signal on the mode ground; at most one Ember cell (the look-here).
signature.density: Texture at 6% opacity or less (BRAND.md section 12), or a hero field at full strength once per page.
signature.motion: Cells change on the beat (L1), never faster than a 1/16 note; static under reduced motion.

borrow_not: Op-art moire and flicker (photosensitive risk, and it fights reading).
Lime or neon palettes from current glyph-matrix posters: the field takes the brand's Signal and Ember.
Chrome and liquid-metal blobs: the iridescent ball is the one hero object.
Full-page neo-brutalist borders: the brand has no outlines; structure comes from surfaces and the grid.
sources: Lindsay Caplan, 'From Collective Creation to Creating Collectives: Arte programmata and the Open Work, 1962', Grey Room 73 (2018)
Karl Gerstner, Designing Programmes (Niggli 1964; Lars Mueller 2007)

web._doc: The website's device programme. Each token is [phone, desktop]. Space tokens interpolate between 375 and 1440 px with clamp() and snap to the 4 px grid; tokens in 'stepped' are controls and radii, which change in one step at the phone breakpoint (640 px) so a control never sits at an odd size. Emitted to brand.css as --web-*; website/system.css maps them onto components.
